newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in slow late trading on Thursday, with few fresh enquiries heard amid talk of lower supply, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.00-55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.75-55.00 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 54.25-54.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"We are only able to collect between 10 to 15 tonnes of rubber per day these days, far lower than the usual 25 to 30 tonnes, due to continued rains," one Palembang dealer said.
March SIR20 deals were last done at 54.50 fob Medan and at 54.00 fob Palembang and Surabaya late on Wednesday, they said.
